plan_review.notes: Adversarial rubber-duck review considered 3 alternative designs before endorsing the chosen one. 2 Blocking concerns (fragile skip/summary same-tick cancellation timing; reduced-motion stacked N reveal cues) fixed architecturally (suppressPhaseChangeHook + reveal coalescing). 2 Non-Blocking concerns (isAvailable() reports support not playability; re-entrant open() overwrites state) accepted as safe-by-construction trade-offs, documented in ADR 0071.
